comparison.objective: Pan a camera to track an unpredictable moving figure and press a cue button without losing the shot; candidate finishes installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous visual tracking through a pan bar plus rapid cross-arm cue response versus static coaxial alignment, bimanual hammering, impact regulation, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Keep the figure framed and press the out-of-reach button within one second of the lamp cue versus four safe physical fractures with all fragments contained.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; closed-loop target tracking and cue reaction are different tested abilities from contact fracture. No specs or framing tolerance are available.
